timing_exclusions: Compilation, Canvas rasterization, file IO, browser capture and native/GPU/human latency are excluded from timings.

pie.classification: Value-proportional clockwise wedges from twelve o’clock; sampled arcs versus analytic upstream arcs.
pie.common_differences: Same 640×480 canvas, 48/32/28/36 margins and source values. Canvas lacks text/legend labels. Moxi retains Cartesian axes/grid even for radial marks; upstream uses its own radial/category presentation. Palette differences, arc tessellation and antialiasing remain. No physical input, native, VoiceOver or human-performance claim.

comparison.assertion: Colored silhouette IoU > 0.98; excludes text/grid/palette identity
